title: Your own folder
summary: A folder of your own on the grid, described by a data card; it waits for the bank and catalog steps.
does: Describes a folder you hold on the grid so that a pipeline can be planned on it: its axes, dtype, targets, modality, person key and licence class are yours to state in the params and the card. Nothing reads it yet: a folder enters the store only through the bank step (tools/ingest.py hashes it into a shard) and the catalog step (CatalogFlow), and a dataset is added by one pull request and one incremental run.

outputs.name: data
outputs.what: Your samples with the axes, dtype, targets and licence you stated; not split.

params.name: axes
params.what: the axes of your samples, in this order; D, H and W give the rank

params.name: targets
params.what: what each sample is labelled with

params.name: modality
params.what: what kind of image or table it is

params.name: persons
params.what: whether each sample names its person, which a split needs

params.name: licence
params.what: the most open recipe of data/recipes/ that admits the whole folder; uncut when not known

today.note: the bank and catalog steps (tools/ingest.py, BankFlow, CatalogFlow) bring a folder in

card.origin: A folder of your own on the grid; you state where it came from in this card.
card.where: The grid's data root, once the bank step has hashed it into a shard (tools/ingest.py).
card.count: You state it; nothing counts it until the bank step does.
card.persons: You state the person key; without one no split can keep a person on one side.
card.split: Not split until a split block assigns the persons.
card.held_out: Nothing is held out until a split block holds it out.
card.licence: You state its class from data/licences.json; it stays uncut until a recipe cuts it.
